metaDescription: WordPress website for Solar Lighting Designs, an Australian solar lighting maker: products by application, project pages, FAQs and a quote request cart.
summary: WordPress website for an Australian commercial solar lighting manufacturer and supplier.
overview: Solar Lighting Designs describes itself as an Australian-owned commercial solar lighting manufacturer and supplier that designs, manufactures, supplies and installs. Pixel2Tech built Solar Lighting Designs' WordPress website as white-label development partner for a digital agency, using Elementor on the Astra theme with WooCommerce for the product catalog.
challenge: Commercial lighting buyers, such as councils, developers and facility managers, compare products by application and want to see real installations before asking for a price. The site had to present a wide product range and a long list of projects, and turn interest into quote requests rather than checkout orders.
approach: The header shows About us, Products, Projects and FAQs, with a Request a Quote button that works as a quote basket. Products are grouped by application, such as street, car park, bollard and walkway, flood, security and site lighting. Project pages show each installation with a photo-led layout, and the home page runs through the company's design, manufacture, supply and install offer, its advantages and customer feedback.
outcome: A B2B website where buyers can browse solar lighting by use, see completed projects and add products to a quote request, from desktop or phone. New products and project pages are added through WordPress as the range and portfolio grow.

process.title: Catalog by application
process.body: Product categories follow how buyers search, from solar street and car park lighting to bollards, flood lights, road safety products and security lights.

process.title: Quote instead of checkout
process.body: WooCommerce runs the catalog, and a Request a Quote basket in the header lets buyers collect products and send one inquiry instead of paying online.

process.title: Project pages
process.body: Each installation has its own page with a full-width photo, a client brief and sharing buttons, linked from a projects grid and a latest projects section on the home page.

process.title: Trust and contact
process.body: The home page covers the design, manufacture, supply and install process, extended warranties, accreditation logos and customer feedback, and the footer lists offices and contact details.

whyItMatters: Commercial buyers rarely buy lighting with a card; they ask for a quote after seeing proof. A catalog built around applications, projects and a quote basket matches how these sales actually happen.

faqs.q: What platform is the Solar Lighting Designs website built on?
faqs.a: It runs on WordPress with Elementor and the Astra theme, with WooCommerce powering the product catalog and the request a quote basket.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build stores and websites under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
